text.en:
of Presidential Decree No. 1352 dated April 21, 1978, is hereby amended so as to include therein
the following:
"14. Those which are exempt under Presidential Decree No. 415"
This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
